title: Prepare Reports Center Eligibility Contract

eligibility_decision.reason: The target is a reports navigation center. It provides links to other reports and exports, but it is not a business report surface with user-owned report filters or independently meaningful saved view state.
eligibility_decision.recommended_next_phase: Exclude report navigation hub views from the rollout selector before selecting the next business report target.

proposed_exclusion.exclusion_rule: ReportSavedViewRolloutSelector should ignore navigation hub candidates such as center.
proposed_exclusion.expected_result_after_exclusion: center should no longer be the next rollout target.

guardrails: Do not add saved view controls to navigation hub pages.
Do not register center in ReportSavedViewRegistry.
Do not add saved view store routes for navigation hub pages.
Do not modify shared saved view partials.
Implement exclusion in selector/prioritization before locking the next target.
